
# Copilot Instructions

VERY_SHORT: true

## Overview

Exprimental fischertechnik RC vehicle project using an ESP32-based gamepad for control. The project includes code for both the ESP32 gamepad and the fischertechnik TXT controller to enable remote operation of the vehicle.

## ATTENTION: **Very important notes**

- The AI should try to make minimal changes to existing code, avoiding adding new functions, excessive checking, abstractions or refactoring (unless absolutely necessary).
- In fact, the AI should make efforts to reduce code size whenever possible, removing unused code, simplifying logic, and avoiding duplication.
- I'm not in a hurry. I prefer to wait for high-quality, elegant code instead of quick fixes.
